mentions.name: Which Temple
mentions.description: This website is a catalogue of ~2,700 temples across India with images sourced from Wikipedia. It shows visitors a random temple on each visit and includes a map view of temples across India. The goal is to expand into a catalogue of all temples worldwide, starting with India and focusing on temples of Indic religions such as Hinduism, Jainism, and Buddhism.
mentions.source_excerpt:
